package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type GetStudentPlanningReadiness struct {
	Reader repository.StudentPlanningReadinessReader
}

func (useCase GetStudentPlanningReadiness) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Reader == nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, errors.New("planning readiness reader is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	source, err := useCase.Reader.ReadPlanningReadiness(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, err
	}
	source.StudentID = studentID
	result, err := domain.BuildStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(source)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}
